about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A42: crowd, budget, five-ingredient, pantry-staples and meal-prep dinners.

recipes.title: Crowd-Pleasing Beef Lasagne for Twelve
recipes.summary: A big tray of beef and tomato lasagne with a creamy white sauce, made to feed a party.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the mince and cook for 10 minutes until browned, then add the tomatoes, paste, oregano and salt and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and stir for 8 minutes until it thickens into a white sauce.

Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Layer meat sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce in a large deep dish, finishing with sauce and the cheeses. Bake for 40 minutes, until golden and bubbling and the centre reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C in the centre; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.
Contains gluten and milk. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Big-Batch Chicken and Vegetable Curry for Ten
recipes.summary: A mild, family-friendly chicken curry with potato and peas that scales happily for a crowd.
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 8 minutes, add the curry powder for 1 minute, then the chicken and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, potato and salt and simmer for 30 minutes, until the potato is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C. Stir in the peas for the last 5 minutes.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes until tender, then serve with the curry and coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C throughout; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Feed-a-Crowd Pulled Beef Sliders
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked beef chuck shredded in barbecue sauce and piled into soft slider rolls with slaw.
steps: Rub the beef with the paprika, garlic powder and salt and brown in the oil for 8 minutes. Place in a roasting dish with the barbecue sauce and stock, cover tightly and braise at 160°C for 4 hours, until the beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef and stir through the sauce in the dish.
Mix the cabbage, carrot, mayonnaise and vinegar for slaw and pile the beef and slaw into the rolls.
notes: Food safety: braise the beef to well above 75°C until tender; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.
Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Pork Shoulder for a Crowd with Apple Slaw
recipes.summary: A big pork shoulder roasted until it pulls apart, served with crunchy apple and cabbage slaw.
steps: Rub the pork with the oil, sugar, paprika, fennel seeds and salt, place in a deep roasting dish with the vinegar and 1 cup of water, cover with foil and roast at 150°C for 5 hours, until the pork shreds and reaches at least 90°C inside.
Shred the pork and toss with the pan juices.
Toss the cabbage, apple and mayonnaise for slaw and pile into the rolls with pork.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 75°C and will be well above that when pull-apart tender; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.
Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Budget Brown Lentil Ragu over Spaghetti
recipes.summary: Brown lentils and grated carrot make a thick, cheap bolognese that feeds a family for a few dollars.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock, oregano and salt and simmer for 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick.
Boil the spaghetti for 10 minutes until al dente, drain and serve with the sauce.
notes: Naturally vegan. About $2.50 a serve.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Budget Egg Fried Rice with Frozen Veg
recipes.summary: A cheap, speedy fried rice with eggs and frozen vegetables, ready in 15 minutes.
steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil for 1 minute until just set, then remove.
Fry the garlic and vegetables in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, add the rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes until piping hot.
Return the egg, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onion and toss through.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until set; use rice that was chilled within 1 hour of cooking and eat leftovers within 1 day, reheated until steaming hot.
Contains egg, soy and sesame. About $1.80 a serve.

recipes.title: Budget Sausage and Veg Tray Bake with Mustard
recipes.summary: Cheap pork sausages roast with potato, carrot and onion, finished with a mustard dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (190°C fan). Toss the potato, carrot, onion, oil and salt on a large tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the sausages and roast for 25 minutes more, turning once, until golden and the sausages reach 75°C in the centre.
Whisk the mustard and vinegar and toss through the tray to serve.
notes: Food safety: pork sausages must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten and mustard. About $3 a serve.

recipes.title: Budget Chickpea and Spinach Curry with Rice
recipes.summary: Pantry chickpeas, tinned tomatoes and frozen spinach make a very cheap, filling vegan curry.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the curry powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, water and salt and simmer for 12 minutes, then stir in the spinach for 3 minutes until hot.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes until tender and serve with the curry. About $1.60 a serve.
notes: Naturally vegan.

recipes.title: Budget Bean and Cheese Quesadillas with Salsa
recipes.summary: Crisp tortillas filled with refried-style beans, cheese and corn, served with quick tomato salsa.

items: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Mash half the beans with the cumin, then mix with the whole beans, corn and cheese.
Spread over four tortillas, top with the rest and cook in the oil in a frying pan for 3 minutes a side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Mix the tomato, onion, lime juice and salt and serve with the cut quesadillas.
notes: Contains gluten and milk. About $2.20 a serve.

recipes.title: Five-Ingredient Baked Chicken Parmigiana
recipes.summary: Crumbed chicken schnitzels baked with tomato passata and mozzarella, using just five ingredients.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Dip the chicken in the egg, then the breadcrumbs, and bake on a tray for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Spoon over the passata and top with mozzarella.
Bake for 8 minutes more, until the cheese is bubbling and the chicken reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; wash hands after handling raw chicken and egg, and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Five-Ingredient Creamy Tomato Chicken Thighs
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs simmered in tomato and cream with garlic, in one pan.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes a side.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, pour in the tomatoes, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Stir in the cream and simmer for 3 minutes. Serve with rice or bread.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Five-Ingredient Honey Mustard Salmon with Potatoes
recipes.summary: Salmon fillets brushed with honey mustard and roasted over crisp baby potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potatoes with the oil on a tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Mix the mustard and honey, brush over the salmon and place on the tray.
Roast for 10 minutes, until the salmon flakes and the potatoes are golden.
notes: Food safety: cook the salmon until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C; eat leftovers cold within 1 day.
Contains fish and mustard.

recipes.title: Five-Ingredient Peanut Noodles with Chicken
recipes.summary: Egg noodles and shredded chicken tossed in a quick peanut and soy sauce.
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 minutes, until it reaches 75°C and is white throughout, then shred.
Cook the noodles for 4 minutes until tender, drain and keep a little water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and 3 tbsp warm noodle water, then toss through the noodles and chicken.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains peanuts, egg, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Five-Ingredient One-Pot Garlic Prawn Rice
recipes.summary: Prawns steamed over garlicky rice in a single pot.
steps: Cook the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, stir in the rice, then add the stock and bring to the boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes, until the rice is nearly tender.
Lay the prawns on top, cover and cook for 5 minutes, until pink and opaque.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque; eat leftovers within 1 day and cool leftover rice within 1 hour.
Contains crustacean shellfish.

recipes.title: Pantry Staples Tuna Pasta Bake
recipes.summary: A tin of tuna, pasta, tinned tomatoes and cheese baked into a cosy dinner.
steps: Boil the penne for 8 minutes until just tender and drain.
Stir through the tuna, tomatoes, corn, oregano and salt and tip into a baking dish. Top with cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
notes: Contains gluten, fish and milk.

Food safety: use tinned tuna within its date and eat leftovers within 2 days. Cooked rice, pasta and legumes spoil quickly: cool leftovers fast, refrigerate within 1 hour, eat within 2 days and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Pantry Staples Rice and Lentil Kitchari
recipes.summary: A soothing one-pot of rice and split red lentils with turmeric and cumin.
steps: Fry the cumin seeds in the oil for 30 seconds until fragrant, stir in the turmeric and coriander, then add the rice, lentils, salt and water.
Simmer, partly covered, for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until everything is soft and porridge-like.
Top with ghee and serve hot.
notes: Contains milk (ghee). Use oil for vegan.

recipes.title: Pantry Staples Baked Bean and Egg Tray
recipes.summary: Baked beans, onion and spice with eggs baked on top, served with toast.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the paprika and baked beans and simmer for 5 minutes.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 6 minutes, until the whites are set.
Season with pepper once the eggs are set and serve with toast.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are set; eat leftovers the same day.
Contains egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Pantry Staples Creamy Chickpea and Tomato Pasta
recipes.summary: Tinned chickpeas and tomatoes simmered into a rich sauce, tossed through pasta.
steps: Boil the pasta for 11 minutes until al dente, saving a cup of cooking water.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the chickpeas, tomatoes, salt and chilli and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the cream, toss through the pasta and loosen with cooking water.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Pantry Staples Potato and Egg Frittata
recipes.summary: A thick potato, onion and egg frittata that needs nothing from the shops but the staples.
steps: Cook the potato and onion in the oil in an ovenproof frying pan for 12 minutes, until tender.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper, pour over and cook on low heat for 5 minutes until the edges set.
Bake at 190°C for 8 minutes, until the centre is firm and golden.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the centre is firm; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains egg.

recipes.title: Meal-Prep Chicken Burrito Bowls for the Week
recipes.summary: Five lunch-and-dinner containers of spiced chicken, rice, black beans and corn that keep for days.

items: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes until tender and drain.
Toss the chicken with the spices, salt and oil and cook in a hot pan for 8 minutes, until it reaches 75°C and is golden.
Divide the rice, chicken, beans, corn and tomato among five containers and finish with lime juice and coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; cool the boxes within 1 hour, refrigerate and eat within 3 days; reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Meal-Prep Turkey Meatballs with Roast Veg and Quinoa
recipes.summary: Baked turkey meatballs, roast vegetables and quinoa packed for four easy meals.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano and salt and roll into 20 meatballs.
Place on a tray with the vegetables tossed in the oil and bake for 25 minutes, until the meatballs reach 75°C.
Simmer the quinoa in 3 cups water for 15 minutes until tender, then divide among four containers with the meatballs and vegetables.
notes: Food safety: turkey mince must reach 75°C in the centre; refrigerate within 1 hour and eat within 3 days.
Contains egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Meal-Prep Teriyaki Tofu and Vegetable Rice Boxes
recipes.summary: Crisp baked tofu and broccoli in sweet teriyaki sauce over rice, packed for the work week.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roast the tofu in the oil with the broccoli and carrot for 20 minutes, until the tofu is golden.
Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, honey and ginger for 3 minutes until syrupy, then toss through the tofu and vegetables.
Divide the rice and tofu among four boxes and top with sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: use rice cooled within 1 hour; refrigerate and eat within 3 days.
Contains soy, gluten and sesame.

recipes.title: Meal-Prep Beef and Sweet Potato Chilli
recipes.summary: A hearty chilli with sweet potato and beans that freezes and reheats beautifully.

items: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the mince and brown for 8 minutes.
Add the sweet potato, beans, tomatoes, spices, salt and stock and simmer for 30 minutes, until the sweet potato is tender and the beef reaches 75°C.
Cool and divide into six containers.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C; cool within 1 hour and refrigerate for 3 days or freeze for 3 months; reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Meal-Prep Souvlaki-Style Chicken Boxes with Cucumber Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Lemon-oregano chicken, rice, cucumber, tomato and tzatziki in four grab-and-go boxes.
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic and salt. Cook in a hot pan or grill for 14 minutes, until it reaches 75°C and is golden.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes until tender.
Slice the chicken and divide among four boxes with the rice, cucumber, tomato and yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C; cool within 1 hour, refrigerate and eat within 3 days.
Contains milk.
